mapper.sql: A.customer_id, A.customer_name, A.customer_no, A.type_id, A.grade_id, A.contact, A.contact_tel, A.user_id, A.customer_remark, A.attachments, A.customer_status, A.customer_address, A.logistics_address, A.other_fields, A.create_time, A.create_by, A.update_time, A.update_by
mapper.select: select p.orderNo, p.orderTime, p.deliveryStatus, p.deliveryNum, if(p.planId = null,p.totalAmount,p.planAmount) totalAmount, -- 总金额 if(p.planId = null,0,p.collectionAmount) collectionAmount, -- 收款金额 if(p.planId = null,p.totalAmount,p.planAmount-p.collectionAmount) unCollectionAmount, -- 未收款金额 if(p.planId = null,"0",if(p.collectionAmount < p.planAmount,if(p.collectionAmount = 0,"0","2"),"1")) priceStatus -- 收款状态 from ( SELECT so.order_no orderNo, -- 订单号 order_time orderTime, -- 日期 sum(omp.materiel_num) deliveryNum, -- 发货数量 ifnull(so.total_amount,0) totalAmount, -- 订单合计金额 ifnull(ocp.plan_amount,0) planAmount, -- 计划收款金额 cd.delivery_status deliveryStatus, -- 送货状态 ifnull(so.collection_amount,0) collectionAmount, -- 收款金额 ocp.plan_id planId FROM brt_sales_order so inner JOIN brt_customer_delivery cd ON cd.order_id = so.order_id left join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_id = cd.order_id left join brt_order_collection_plan ocp on ocp.order_id = so.order_id where cd.customer_id = #{marketRecordVo.customerId} group by so.order_id )p
